purpose: Select and freeze fixed conservative storage partitions and adversarial state pairs without inspecting any identical-future-probe response.

diagnostic_state_scale.provenance: independently frozen B01 ROM-0/ROM-1 theta numerical scale used historically for state distinguishability

candidates.family: all contiguous fixed partitions of the 16 x 10-cm base cells
candidates.coordinate: layer mean theta; exactly information-equivalent to fixed-layer storage W_i after multiplication by layer thickness
candidates.collision_at_multiplier: all candidate layer-mean differences <= multiplier * diagnostic theta_floor while full theta L_inf exceeds diagnostic theta_floor
candidates.score: exact hierarchical evaluation of the frozen lexicographic collision-count score [4,2,1,0.5,0.25]: exhaust all partitions at 4x; evaluate only exact minimum-count ties at each subsequent multiplier; final tie uses lexicographically smallest cut tuple
candidates.reason: favor partitions that remain state-separating as the purely diagnostic proximity neighborhood is widened

adversarial_pair_freeze.selected_partitions: one response-blind selected partition per dimension plus all fixed controls
adversarial_pair_freeze.rule: among cross-history full-state-distinguishable pairs, select the eight smallest candidate-coordinate L_inf distances; tie-break by larger full theta L_inf then history/step key

outputs: minimum collision count and tie count per dimension at the widest 4x diagnostic proximity
response-blind selected partition per dimension under the exact hierarchical lexicographic score
all five diagnostic multiplier collision counts for each selected partition and fixed control
full-state contrast for each frozen pair

next_gate.name: LARE-RS1-GW-P2
next_gate.rule: Freeze purpose-dependent future-probe horizons and acceptance envelopes before executing future responses for P1 pairs.

pre_execution_method_clarification.reason: Avoid multiplying the exact all-pair bitset workload across five proximity scales while preserving the frozen response-blind ranking.
pre_execution_method_clarification.method: Evaluate every partition first at the widest 4x diagnostic proximity. For each dimension retain all minimum-collision ties. Evaluate only those ties successively at 2x, 1x, 0.5x and 0.25x until one or more ties remain; final tie-break is lexicographic cut tuple. Fixed controls and the finally selected partition per dimension are then reported at all five multipliers.
pre_execution_method_clarification.scientific_effect: None. This is algebraically identical to the already frozen lexicographic score [4,2,1,0.5,0.25] and uses no future response.
